list.name: manual_resource
list.label: 수동 억제 자원 (Slack)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT resource_arn FROM (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, resource.uid as resource_arn, status, unmapped['Note.UpdatedBy'] as suppressed_by, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'Suppressed' AND suppressed_by IS NOT NULL AND suppressed_by NOT LIKE 'automation-rule-%' AND suppressed_by != 'terraform-managed-risk-acceptance' ORDER BY 1

query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT resource_arn FROM (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, resource.uid as resource_arn, status, unmapped['Note.UpdatedBy'] as suppressed_by, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'Suppressed' AND suppressed_by IS NOT NULL AND suppressed_by NOT LIKE 'automation-rule-%' AND suppressed_by != 'terraform-managed-risk-acceptance' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 영역 A. 수동 예외 처리 (Slack 승인 기반 거버넌스)
🙋 수동 억제 리소스 요약
panels.description: 사람이 직접 Slack 모달로 예외 승인한 자원 목록 - 자원 하나당 한 행(승인자, 만료 예정일, 총 수동 억제 건수). CloudWatch Logs(/aws/cspm/exception-records)가 소스라 이 플로우로 등록된 것만 정확히 잡힌다(자동 억제/구버전 스크립트 안 섞임). 만료 예정일은 그 자원에 exception이 여러 건이면 가장 최근 등록 건 기준(정확한 최솟값은 CWLI가 문자열 필드 min()을 지원 안 해서 근사치).

targets.expression:
fields eventType, resourceId, approvedBy, reviewDate
| filter eventType = 'CSPM_EXCEPTION_RECORDED'
| stats count(*) as `총_수동억제`, latest(approvedBy) as `승인자`, latest(reviewDate) as `만료_예정일` by resourceId
| sort `만료_예정일` asc
targets.queryString:
fields eventType, resourceId, approvedBy, reviewDate
| filter eventType = 'CSPM_EXCEPTION_RECORDED'
| stats count(*) as `총_수동억제`, latest(approvedBy) as `승인자`, latest(reviewDate) as `만료_예정일` by resourceId
| sort `만료_예정일` asc

panels.title: 🔍 수동 억제 자원의 미조치 Finding 상세
panels.description: 상단 '수동 억제 자원' 변수에서 고른 자원에 아직 남아있는 미조치(NEW) finding 목록. 같은 자원이라도 사람이 승인한 건 하나뿐이고 나머지 컨트롤은 그대로 미조치 상태로 남아있을 수 있다 - 그걸 보여준다.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, finding_info.title as title, severity, status, time_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0 WHERE resource.uid = '$manual_resource') SELECT title as "제목", severity as "심각도", status as "상태", time_dt as "최종갱신" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'New' ORDER BY severity DESC, "최종갱신" DESC

panels.title: 영역 B. 자동 예외 처리 (Tag 기반 정책 자동화)
🏷️ 자동 억제 리소스 요약
panels.description: Automation Rule(46-cspm-automation-rules.tf)이 자동으로 예외 처리한 자원 목록 - 자원 하나당 한 행(감지된 태그, 적용된 규칙명, 총 자동 억제 건수). 한 자원이 dev 태그 규칙과 known-accepted-risks 규칙 둘 다에 걸릴 수 있어 규칙명이 여러 개로 표시될 수 있다.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, resource.uid as resource_arn, resource.labels as labels, status, unmapped['Note.UpdatedBy'] as suppressed_by, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0) SELECT resource_arn as "리소스", arbitrary(array_join(labels, ', ')) as "감지된_태그", array_join(array_distinct(array_agg(suppressed_by)), ', ') as "자동억제_규칙명", count(*) as "총_자동억제_수" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'Suppressed' AND suppressed_by LIKE 'automation-rule-%' GROUP BY resource_arn ORDER BY "총_자동억제_수" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 🔍 자동 억제 자원의 미조치 Finding 상세
panels.description: 상단 '자동 억제 자원' 변수에서 고른 자원에서, 태그/규칙으로 억제되지 않고 아직 살아있는 미조치(NEW) finding 목록 - 심각도 높은 순으로 정렬해서 진짜 위험한 게 dev 태그 뒤에 숨어있지 않은지 확인할 수 있다.

targets.rawSQL: WITH latest AS (SELECT finding_info.uid as uid, finding_info.title as title, severity, status, time_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY finding_info.uid ORDER BY time_dt DESC) as rn FROM amazon_security_lake_table_ap_northeast_2_sh_findings_2_0 WHERE resource.uid = '$auto_resource') SELECT title as "제목", severity as "심각도", status as "상태", time_dt as "최종갱신" FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'New' ORDER BY severity DESC, "최종갱신" DESC
